//----- Regenerated by session tooling from the final patched project.json -----------------------------------------

WhenGreenFlagClicked()
{
  menucounter = '0';
  Motion.GoToXY('36', '28');
  looks_setsizeto fields={} inputs={ SIZE: '100' };
  Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(costume1);
  Looks.Show();
}

WhenThisSpriteClicked()
{
  menucounter += '1';
}

WhenBroadcastReceived(show)
{
  Control.Wait('0.01');
  Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(costume1);
  Motion.GoToXY('36', '28');
  menucounter = '0';
}

WhenThisSpriteClicked()
{
  Call toggle cam menu();
}

WhenKeyPressed(space)
{
  Call toggle cam menu();
}

WhenKeyPressed(space)
{
  menucounter += '1';
}

Define toggle cam menu
{
  Control.Wait('0.1');
  If ((menucounter == '1'))
  {
    Event.Broadcast('hide');
    Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(costume2);
    Motion.GoToXY('36', '28');
  }
  If ((menucounter == '2'))
  {
    Event.Broadcast('show');
  }
}

costume1.svg
costume2.svg
